subject.title: Gateway Dashboard chat buttons lose busy state after tab switch and can interrupt active runs

question: Is current main's session-row active-run recovery sufficient to close this issue and supersede the open closing PR, or should a current-main replacement for that PR still land first?
rationale: Source now shows stronger active-run UI recovery than earlier reviews, but the issue remains paired with an unmerged closing PR and lacks live tab-switch proof that maintainers have accepted as sufficient.

options.title: Resolve the linked PR first
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers either close https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41067 as superseded with proof or replace/rebase it for remaining recovery work.

options.title: Close after current-main proof
options.body: If maintainers accept a current-main Dashboard proof that Stop/Queue survives tab return during an active run, close this issue as implemented and then clean up the stale PR separately.

options.title: Open a replacement fix
options.body: If live proof still shows a gap, use a narrow current-main replacement rather than reviving the stale protocol/shutdown parts of the old PR wholesale.

recommendation.title: Resolve the linked PR first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers either close https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41067 as superseded with proof or replace/rebase it for remaining recovery work.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored the merged reconnect mitigation closest to this issue's Stop/Queue recovery path.
